test_objective: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context

test_cases.name: 001_05_01 Create one entity using the default context with JSON content type and request without context
test_cases.doc: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context, requesting without context
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-simple-attributes-sample.json'
}

test_cases.when:
